summary: FQCNs have a namespace (company or group), collection name (product or OS), and a lowercase, underscore-separated, singular plugin name; GitHub org and repo names needn't match Galaxy names, but plugin names do.
questions: How should I name modules in my collection?
Should module names be singular or plural?
Does my GitHub repo name have to match my Galaxy collection name?

answer_card.title: Collection naming conventions
answer_card.answer_md:
FQCN = **namespace** (company/group) + **collection** (product/OS) + **plugin name** (lowercase, `_` separators, singular: `command` not `commands`). E.g. `community.mongodb.mongodb_linux`.

Matching GitHub org/repo to Galaxy names is convenient but optional; plugin names are always identical in repo and artifact.
